content.short: AiBased is an AI-powered creative studio for instantly generating and minting unique onchain art as NFTs.
content.description: AiBased is a creative platform that makes onchain art creation accessible to everyone. Founded in 2024 by Costantino, it provides tools for artists, collectors, and curious newcomers to explore AI-driven art. Users can generate images in six styles, get inspiration from an AI assistant, and build a digital identity through a gamified mission system. By connecting a wallet and entering a text prompt, they mint the resulting artwork as an ERC-721 NFT on the Base blockchain.
